text_sanskrit: प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः । अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥ ६-४५ ॥
itrans: prayatnAdyatamAnastu yogI sa.nshuddhakilbiShaH . anekajanmasa.nsiddhastato yAti parAM gatim .. 6-45 ..
translation:
But endeavouring with great effort he becomes the Yogi destitute of all evil and becomes accomplished through many lives; thereupon he reaches the highest goal. (45)
V. He: even he who seeks to know of Yoga, Endeavouring: making endeavours when he has known what Yoga is. Thereupon: when he is accomplished of Yoga, i.e., when he has realised Brahman, 
A. The Yoga taught here is now praised.
